data.name: Ilatfat
data.gender_notes: Ilatfat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ilatfat is derived from the Arabic root letters 'l-t-f', which means 'to deliver' or 'to give'. It implies a sense of relief, salvation, and deliverance from difficulties. This name is mentioned in the Quran as a title for Allah, signifying His ability to provide relief and succor to His believers. The name Ilatfat carries the meaning “Deliverance, Relief, Salvation” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ilatfat usually hope their child will grow to embody deliverance, relief, salvation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
